source.directorySummary: Provides web rendering for the file tree command including stylesheet, icon, and interactive WebNode tree with navigation, expand/collapse, and file operations.

stylesheet.ts.sourceSummary: Exports filePluginTreeStylesheet WebStyleSheet with id 'file-plugin-tree' and cssText styling the file tree modal layout, tree blocks, rows, inline forms, breadcrumbs and control buttons.

tree.svg.sourceSummary: SVG icon with a folder and indented tree lines filled with currentColor.

web.ts.sourceSummary: Renders the workspace file tree as WebNodes/WebActions handling refresh, reveal, navigation, expand state, create/rename/delete forms, diff/history, search and bottom-up actions with breadcrumb and stylesheet integration.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Terminal web-presentation leaf delegated by plugins/file/commands/tree to isolate browser-specific interactive rendering from parent's depth/target parsing, workspace containment/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering, and git-status bubbling. Completes the dual CLI/web execution split for the read-only discovery surface — parent owns data-building for both paths, this directory owns lazy expansion/navigation/file-ops UI for web consumers routed through the centralized adapter/handleFile dispatch — with no further children or filesystem mutation ownership.

files.stylesheet.ts: Decoupled presentation asset for the web execution path; provides scoped 'file-plugin-tree' WebStyleSheet consumed by web.ts to style modal, tree blocks/rows, inline forms, breadcrumbs and controls without coupling styling to WebNode construction or action logic.
files.tree.svg: Static plugin-registered command icon for the tree subcommand; theme-adaptive via currentColor folder/tree-lines glyph used in command palettes and web UI chrome, independent of dynamic tree rendering in web.ts.
files.web.ts: Web execution implementation of the tree subcommand; transforms parent-validated and filtered directory data into stateful WebNodes/WebActions with breadcrumb, stylesheet integration, lazy expand/collapse, reveal/refresh, navigation, inline create/rename/delete forms, and delegation to diff/history/search/bottom-up actions — bridging to sibling file/git commands rather than implementing mutations itself.
